newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer to speak in Freiburg,Germany at 1800 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer to speak in Freiburg,Germany at 1800 GMT.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer will hold a speech in Freiburg at 1800 GMT this evening, the Bundesbank said.
The speech will celebrate the hundredth anniversary of the birth on February 4 of Ludwig Erhard, a former German economics minister who is seen as the father of the social market economy.
The speech bears the title "The stability of the value of money and the social market economy in the age of global markets".
